topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: Finding the ring in the pawn shop was a twist of fate, a narrow corridor leading back to a time I thought was lost. The glint of the diamond did more than catch the light; it snagged a piece of my heart, pulling me back to the kitchen table where it once rested on Gran’s hand. I trace the engravings, familiar yet distant, my fingers trembling slightly. Each line, each curve, whispers of her laughter, her warmth, the way she used to say my name with that peculiar smile. The shop is quiet around me, the weight of everything unspoken settling in my chest. I shouldn’t feel this much, not here, not now, but the ring—they don’t understand what it holds.
